page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2c.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 88.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, this x86_64 architecture server features 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. A key hardware characteristic is the inclusion of 11918 GB of local HDD storage, making it highly dense in storage capacity.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests falling into the bottom 25 percent. However, multi-core capabilities scale to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching middle-tier performance. Memory bandwidth is stable, offering average read and write speeds for both cached and uncached blocks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d2c.6xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, trading off high-speed SSD performance and top-tier single-core compute for massive local HDD capacity. This makes it a practical choice for workloads requiring large-scale data storage with moderate compute needs. Appropriate workloads include distributed file systems, big data processing, log archiving, and cold data storage.
